description: Desktop Codex/Claude Code deployment. SAAM works without a code; optional invite activation enables update service and official-alpha diagnostics. No diagnostics are collected before activation. Simple Connect-panel statement; no separate offline or speculative compatibility subsystem. Release & diagnostics service is a working name.

agent.label: Desktop agent
agent.description: Codex or Claude Code executes user-requested installation.

nodes.label: Chat installer
nodes.description: Version-pinned release instructions for a desktop agent.

nodes.label: Local SAAM installation
nodes.description: Release code; transactional update and rollback.

nodes.label: Studio Connect
nodes.description: Optional alpha invite; simple update/diagnostics statement.

nodes.label: Release & diagnostics service
nodes.description: Invite validation, update manifests and consented diagnostics.

nodes.label: Local bundles
nodes.description: Local recipes, assets, extension references and review artifacts.

nodes.label: Extension package exchange
nodes.description: Export/import packages; promotion through release review.

contracts.label: install URL
contracts.inputs: Documented release URL and supported desktop/OS.
contracts.outputs: Verified pinned package and install instructions.
contracts.excludes: No web agent runtime or executable bootstrap fetched without identity verification.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: install / upgrade
contracts.inputs: Verified release and existing local installation.
contracts.outputs: Working local installation or restored previous version.
contracts.effects: Replace release code, preserve user data; supply migration guidance only for actual breaking changes.
contracts.excludes: No overwrite of local bundles or extension edits.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: connect alpha services
contracts.inputs: Invite code and minimal installation identity over authenticated transport.
contracts.outputs: Credential for updates and official-alpha diagnostics.
contracts.effects: Service activation state; credentials privately owned by local install.
contracts.excludes: No code required to use SAAM; no chat relay, remote agent execution or printer access.
contracts.failure: Report connection/invalid-invite failure without disabling SAAM.

contracts.label: store activation
contracts.outputs: Optional service connection status; SAAM remains usable without a code.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: update manifest
contracts.inputs: Activated installation identity and current release/platform.
contracts.outputs: Update manifest, release notes/migration guidance when needed and verified release artifact.
contracts.excludes: No update service for unactivated users; no update during a job or overwrite of user data.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: live diagnostic events
contracts.inputs: Live SAAM emitter events from activated-alpha tool calls and runtime boundaries; proposed job/stage, extension and install/update fields.
contracts.outputs: Immediate service receipt/status; local work never waits on diagnostic success.
contracts.effects: Live emission only while activated and connected; the service may retain received events for the provisional existing 30 days.
contracts.excludes: No emission/diagnostic collection from unactivated users; no backfill, chat transcript/reasoning, credentials or bulk files. Compact large arrays and redact sensitive fields.
contracts.failure: Drop unavailable diagnostic delivery without blocking SAAM; no offline backlog or record-then-upload pipeline.

contracts.label: resolve dependencies
contracts.inputs: Bundle extension references and local library.
contracts.outputs: Resolved extension or actionable missing-dependency error.
contracts.effects: Library-owned storage preserving local edits; guidance for actual breaking changes.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: open / save
contracts.inputs: Bundle identity, assets and extension references.
contracts.outputs: Bundle snapshot or actionable error with migration guidance when needed.
contracts.effects: Atomic saves; no speculative migration framework.
contracts.excludes: No silent regeneration of confirmed programs.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: package / import
contracts.inputs: Manifest, scripts, guidance, declared assets and version digest.
contracts.outputs: Portable extension package or namespaced installed version.
contracts.excludes: No scripts hidden in bundles; imported scripts do not autorun.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: release candidate
contracts.outputs: Individual contribution review; later release may include an explicitly accepted extension.
contracts.effects: Explicit contribution upload only when requested.
contracts.excludes: No automatic harvesting or promotion of local edits.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.
